# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c30 P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley
- **Role:** Student

## Appearance

Flossie is a student known for wearing fashionable dresses featuring flounces. She was once described as having red hair.

## Personality

Flossie possesses a moody, bold, and caustic-tongued temperament. She is not hesitant to ask direct questions and openly disdains classroom recitations. Marked by a vindictive streak, she holds grudges, delights in mocking others, and displays spiteful behavior toward her peers. She is also superstitious, believing that the number thirteen brings bad luck.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007)_

## Traits

- Bold  <sub>[v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031)</sub>
- Caustic-tongued
- Superstitious  <sub>[v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007)</sub>
- Vindictive

## Abilities

- Knitting lace

## Goals

- To gain an education without needing to earn a living  <sub>[v1 c30 P22](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0022)</sub>

## History

Flossie attended Brierley school, where she was the last of her family to enroll. She was part of the Regent's class under Miss Thorne, studying subjects alongside classmates like Nell Harcourt, Isolde, Odette Pullen, and Opal Pettigrew. Prior to the Entrance examinations, she questioned Miss Thorne on whether she would return to teach the following year. Flossie traveled to the Academy with her peers to take the examinations, where she noted to Nell that number thirteen brings bad luck and expressed doubt about Nell's strength to endure the teacher's course. After passing her examinations, she moved to the city to attend the Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c30 P30](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0030), [v1 c32 P7](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0007), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016)_

## Background by volume

- Her father is wealthy enough to afford her education without requiring her to work  <sub>[v1 c30 P22](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0022)</sub>
- She was the last member of the Tulk family to attend Brierley school after twenty years of her family's attendance
- She lost her top rank in class after misspelling the word 'ebullition'
